title: Graceful Shutdown and Connection Draining
description: Adds built‑in handling for SIGTERM/SIGINT to stop accepting new requests, wait for in‑flight requests to finish, and then exit cleanly. This prevents dropped requests during deployments and improves reliability in production environments.
testCases: Simulate SIGTERM while handling an active request and verify the server stops accepting new connections but allows the active request to complete before exiting
Trigger SIGINT with no active requests and ensure the server exits immediately after cleanup
acceptance: When the process receives SIGTERM or SIGINT, the server must stop accepting new connections, allow existing requests to finish within a configurable timeout (default 10 s), then close all listeners and exit with code 0. Logs must indicate shutdown start, request draining status, and final exit. All tests pass and no unhandled promise rejections occur.
reason: Ensures production‑grade reliability by handling process termination gracefully, reducing request loss during restarts, and aligning yantraverse with best practices for zero‑downtime deployments.
